hero.tagline: Developer focused on back-end and games, with experience in industrial systems, web, and automation.

about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I'm Leonardo, and I graduated in Computer Science from FEI in 2023. For almost three years I worked as a developer at SPI Integração de Sistemas, building shop-floor systems — mainly MES, for clients such as CVale and Cummins — as well as websites and automations (RPA).
In 2025 I spent a year and a half in Ireland, where I earned the Cambridge B2 English certificate and lived in an international environment that strengthened my communication and adaptability.
Back in Brazil, I'm looking for new opportunities as a developer, focusing on back-end and game development. I enjoy challenges, work well in a team, and am determined.
